content: Thessalonica Theng
Paul le Silas te Amphipolis le Apollonia a kantan zawk uh ciang in, Thessalonica theng uh hi, tua mun ah Judah te synagogue om hi:
Taciang Paul sia ama ngeina bang in, synagogue sungah tum a, sabbath ni nithum sung amate taw laithiangtho sung thu te kikum uh hi.
Christ sia a thuak kul hamtang a hina le thina pan thokik hamtang tu hi; ci in note tungah ka pualak hi Jesus sia Christ a hihi, ci in pualak in hil thiang hi.
Amate sung pan pawlkhat te in um uh a, Paul le Silas te kipawlpui uh hi; taciang tua te sungah biakna sang a kipumpiak Greek mihon tampi le numei lampui tampi kihel uh hi.

Ahihang a um ngawl Judah mite in haza uh a, van zuakna lamdung a vakvai mannung ngawl mite sam uh hi, taciang honpi khat hong pha uh a khuapi sungah buaina piangsak uh hi, taciang Jason i inn sim uh a, mipi mai ah pusua tu in zong uh hi.
Taciang amate in a mu ngawl uh ciang in, Jason le suapui pawlkhat te khuapi ulian te kungah kai uh a, hileitung lumlet te himun zong ah hongpai uh hi;
Amate sia Jason in ama inn ah tungsak hi: hi te theampo in Caesar thupiakna te langpan uh a, Jesus a kici a dang kumpi khat om hi, ci uh hi, ci in au lialua uh hi.
Hi thu te mipi te le khuapi ulian te in a zak uh ciang in, buai mama uh hi.
Taciang Jason le a dang te sia a kisam za dangka liausak uh a, tua zawkciang in thaa kik uh hi.
Berea Theng
Zan ciang in suapui te in Paul le Silas te Berea ah a zan a zan in paisak uh hi: tua mun a thet uh ciang in Judah mite i synagogue sungah tum uh hi.
Hi te sia Thessalonica mite sang in a thinsung uh phazaw hi, thalawptak in thu ngai uh a, tua a ngai uh thu te a man le man ngawl nisim laithiangtho sungah zong uh hi.
Tua ahikom amate sung panmi tampi in um uh a; a zatak huai Greek nupi pasal tampi zong kihel uh hi.
Ahihang Thesslonica a om Judah mite in Berea khua ah zong Paul in Pathian thuhil hi, ci a heak uh ciang in, hongpai uh a, mipi te thawn uh hi.
Tua zawk pociang in suapui te in Paul sia tuipi sangah paisak uh hi: ahihang Silas le Timothy sia Berea ah taamlai hi.
Paul a tha te in Athens dong tha uh hi: taciang Silas le Timothy sia manlangtak a pai natu in Paul kung pan thupiak nga uh a, pai uh hi.
Athen Theng
Paul in Athen pan Silas le Timothy te ngak in a om laitak, tua khuapi sungah milim biakna bebek om hi, ci a mu ciang in, a thinsung sutha mama hi.
Tua ahikom Judah biakna lampui te taw synagogue sungah thu ki nial uh a, vanzuakna ah a kisikpui te taw nisim in ki nial uh hi.

Tuazawkciang in thu ngaisun thiam Epicurean te le Stoic te taw ki mu uh hi. Taciang pawlkhat te in, hi a papau sia bang son ziam? a dang pawlkhat te zong in, hisia pa sia ngamdang te pathian te thu son hi tu hi, ci uh hi: banghangziam cile Paul in amate tungah Jesus le a thawkikna thu son hi.
Taciang amate in Paul man uh hi, taciang Areopagas ah paipui uh a, hi hilna thak na son te kote zong ka heak tu uh kisam ziam?
Banghangziam cile a tumdang te ka bil uh ah nong zasak hi: hi thu te i deina sia bangziam, ci ka he nuam uh hi, ci uh hi.
Banghangziam cile Athen mite le leangna te theampo in thuthak son tu, a hibale ngai tu simngawl bangma dang atu amate hun a zang bua uh hi.
Tuazawkciang in Paul sia Mars mual laizang ah ding a, no Athen mite, note sia na theampo nasiatak thuciing cimteam mama te na hi uh hi, ci kong he hi.

Banghangziam cile ka vakawm in biakna sang na hanciam nate uh ka en a, a ki he ngawl pathian atu ci a ki at biaktau khat ka mu hi. Tua ahikom note in he ngawlpi in na biak uh Pathian thu kong pualak hi.
Tua Pathian sia leitung le a sung om theampo a vawtpa a hihi, ama sia van le lei i Topa hi a, khut taw a kisa biakinn sungah om ngawl hi;
Pathian sia mi theampo tungah nuntakna, husanna le na theampo a piapa ahikom, mihing te khut taw i vawtsak tu bangma kisam ngawl hi;
Taciang Ama in leitung theampo ah a om minam theampo sia thisan khat in vawt a, amate om tu hun te le a om natu mun te zong ngealkholsak siat hi;
Tabang in amate in Topa zong uh a, tham in a mu thei natu a hihi, Pathian sia eite khatsim kuama taw ki khuala ngawl hi:
Banghangziam cile i nungta a, i tuk i dian le i hina theampo sia Ama sungah a hihi; tasia bangma in na laphuak te in zong, eite zong Ama suan te i hihi, ci hi.
Tabang in Pathian suan te i hi man in, mihing te khutthiam le ngaisutna taw a kivawt kham, ngun le suangtum milim bang in Pathian sia i ngaisut tu hi ngawl hi.
Mihing te in Pathian a heak ma hunlai in Pathian in a mu ngawl bang in omthong ngei napi; tu in mun theampo ah a om mi theampo maw ki sikkik natu in thupia hi:

Banghangziam cile nasep a piaksa mihing khat zang in leitung ah thutang suana tungtawn thu a khen tu ni ciangtan zo hi; tua thu sia a ma a hihi, ci in mi theampo tungah kilangsak tu in tua pa sia thina pan thokiksak zo hi, ci hi.
Amate in mithi te thawkikna thu a zak uh ciang in, mi pawlkhat te in selno uh hi: a dang te in, hi thu nangtung pan ka za kik nuam uh hi, ci uh hi.
Taciang Paul sia amate sung pan in pusuak hi.
Ahihang mi pawlkhat te in ama beal uh a, um uh hi: tua te sungah Areopagas mi Dionysius, Damaris a kici nupi khat le midang te zong kihel uh hi.
